items.readable_text:
Content:
The expected value (also known as the expectation or mean) of a continuous random variable is the average value we'd expect to get if we observed the random variable many times.

Content:
For a continuous random variable [MATH: X] with probability density function [MATH: f(x)] defined over a set [MATH: S,] we can calculate the expected value using the following formula:

Content:
[MATH: \textrm E[X] = \int_S x \cdot f(x) \, \textrm dx]

Content:
For example, consider the continuous random variable [MATH: X] with the following probability density function:

Content:
[MATH: f(x) = \dfrac{x}{4}, \quad 1 < x < 3]

Content:
We compute the expected value as follows:
[MATH: E[X]|= ∫_{1}^{3}x ⋅ (x)/(4)dx; = ∫_{1}^{3}(x^{2})/(4)dx; = (x^{3})/(12)|_{1}^{3}; = (13)/(6)]

[MATH: f(x) = \dfrac{3x^2}{7}, \quad 1 < x < 2]

sections.normalized_html:
First, we simplify using the properties of expected value:

[MATH: \textrm E[7X-4] = 7 \textrm E[X] - 4]

For a continuous random variable [MATH: X] with probability density function [MATH: f(x)] defined over a set [MATH: S,] we can calculate the expected value using the following formula:

[MATH: \textrm{E}[X] = \int_S x \cdot f(x) \,\textrm{d}x]

So, we calculate the expected value of [MATH: X] as follows:

[MATH: E[X]|= ∫_{S}x ⋅ f(x)dx; = ∫_{1}^{2}x ⋅ (3x^{2})/(7)dx; = ∫_{1}^{2}(3x^{3})/(7)dx; = (3x^{4})/(28)|_{1}^{2}; = (45)/(28)]

Therefore,

[MATH: E[7X − 4]|= 7E[X] − 4; = 7 ⋅ (45)/(28) − 4; = (29)/(4).]

Item 1 — Tutorial: Introduction

The expected value (also known as the expectation or mean) of a continuous random variable is the average value we'd expect to get if we observed the random variable many times.

Content:
For a continuous random variable [MATH: X] with probability density function [MATH: f(x)] defined over a set [MATH: S,] we can calculate the expected value using the following formula:

Content:
[MATH: \textrm E[X] = \int_S x \cdot f(x) \, \textrm dx]

Content:
For example, consider the continuous random variable [MATH: X] with the following probability density function:

Content:
[MATH: f(x) = \dfrac{x}{4}, \quad 1 < x < 3]

Content:
We compute the expected value as follows:
[MATH: E[X]|= ∫_{1}^{3}x ⋅ (x)/(4)dx; = ∫_{1}^{3}(x^{2})/(4)dx; = (x^{3})/(12)|_{1}^{3}; = (13)/(6)]
